metadata.title: Reconstructing built-up land in Toruń and Bydgoszcz (Poland) 1975–2025 from Landsat with a Dynamic World-trained Random Forest: GeoTIFF map series and probability stacks
metadata.description:
GeoTIFF rasters (EPSG:2180) produced by the Random Forest label-transfer procedure described in the companion code record: series A built-up maps 1985–2025 (30 m, cumulative, 11 epochs), series B maps 2018–2025 from Sentinel-2 (10 m), Landsat MSS maps 1975 and 1980 (60 m, shown on the 30 m grid), raw probability stacks p(built-up) per epoch and the Sentinel-2 summer 2025 median composite used as map background, for the Toruń and Bydgoszcz map frames and study zones. Nodata value, band order and epoch years are given in README_rastry.md. Code, result tables, model cards and point panels are deposited in the companion software record (see related identifiers).

Rastry GeoTIFF (EPSG:2180) z procedury transferu etykiet: seria A 1985–2025 (30 m), seria B 2018–2025 (10 m), mapy MSS 1975 i 1980 (60 m), stosy prawdopodobieństwa p(zabudowa) oraz kompozyt Sentinel-2 z lata 2025 dla ramek map Torunia i Bydgoszczy. Opis pasm, wartości nodata i lat epok w README_rastry.md.
